rows.name: stuck states
rows.detail: every status has an exit (HELD/VOID -> team; RUGGED after the window -> REDISTRIBUTING -> one bonus per claim -> CLOSED, or straight to the registry's fund when nobody claimed; ACTIVE with no cursor movement for the recovery window -> the registry's fund; credits withdrawable; stray swept); a flood of 1,000+ LP transfers out is scanned across checks and the recovery deadline moves with every check that moves the cursor: 71 tests; on chain: 17 replay bonds on 0x42f22d3C3d782E678C0561217276be836cba93fb: 17 at the expected verdict and rug block; 17 settled (11 to the registry's fund after a claim window in which nobody claimed, 6 back to the launchpad); 19/19 checks stored by GenVM read identically from this machine

rows.name: evidence binding
rows.detail: a RUGGED verdict stores R, its timestamp, the LP transfers out in R (tx hashes), LP before/after and the R-1 token snapshot; the pair must be one its listed factory maps back; claims bind to msg.sender, to balances at the start block and R-1 and to the summed transfers from team senders, all read from two RPCs (a team transfer subtracts its own amount; zero-value and dust transfers disqualify nobody); 74 tests

rows.name: two sources
rows.detail: two log RPCs and two state RPCs per chain from different operators; any disagreement or failure is PENDING, never a verdict; validators derive the range from the bond's stored cursor and span and accept a leader's failure only if their own read fails (42 offline tests, 8 Direct Mode validator tests); feasibility study on the first read code, GenVM: 39/39 feasibility reads and 2/2 claim reads identical to this machine's

rows.name: identity
rows.detail: the claimant is msg.sender (claim takes only the bond id); a beneficiary is committed once by the holder itself; the team is the bond's sender and names no destination: unclaimed GEN goes to claimants or to the registry's fund, fixed in the constructor; 13 tests
